description: Capability for the bootstrap window. No `remote` origin grant: the user-configured server URL must never be allowlisted for Tauri IPC access -- see docs/plans/2026-08-12-001-feat-desktop-app-plan.md KTD9. The window:allow-set-* permissions are for expanding the chromeless bootstrap window to a normal, resizable, titled window right before navigating to the real app (main.ts's expandToAppWindow) -- core:default only grants read-only window queries, not these mutations.
